name: SessionChannels
description: TauSync meeting-word identifiers for session lifecycle events. Both PC and Android must call tau.connect() with the exact same string — define it here once and generate both sides.

members.name: DISCONNECT_FROM_PHONE
members.description: Phone opens this channel when it initiates a disconnect.

members.name: DISCONNECT_FROM_PC
members.description: PC opens this channel to notify the phone before a PC-initiated disconnect.
